ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached figure shows two diagonal straight lines j and k, with identical pink arrow marks beside them, indicating j ∥ k; another diagonal line l crosses these two parallel lines. At the left intersection, angles 1, 2, 3, 4 are labeled, among which angle 2 is located on the exterior side of the parallel lines; at the right intersection, angles 5, 6, 7, 8 are labeled, among which angle 7 is also located on the exterior side of the parallel lines. Reasoning: According to the positions in the figure, ∠2 and ∠7 are alternate exterior angles formed by the parallel lines j, k being cut by the transversal l, so their measures are equal. Given m∠2 = 4x + 7, m∠7 = 5x - 13, therefore 4x + 7 = 5x - 13. Solving gives 7 = x - 13, so x = 20.
